# Volunteer handbook

Supported practice is our induction method: work beside an experienced person through a real opening shift, practise fallback choices, and name the helper available during breaks. Returning volunteers may request it after software changes or time away. The safety policy is still in force; use the terminology crosswalk for the annual compliance training return.

The key card stays in the secure box. Inspect exits and the floor, compare the room with its dated photograph and pause opening if it is unsafe. Damaged tools need a description, owner and review date. Rafi may refuse work outside our scope. [[Maintenance]] records delegated decisions. This handbook must be usable by someone without its author's private knowledge.
